data.name: Financial Planning & Analysis Associate
data.jobDescription:
Job Description

We’re seeking someone to join our Hong Kong team as a Finance Business Partner in the Infrastructure Finance responsible for financial and business management oversight of the Infrastructure divisions as well as understand Infrastructure allocations to business unit. The candidate will also work closely with Infrastructure stakeholders and division COO offices to review financial performance, analyze trends and provide forward-looking insights.


In the Finance division, we act as a partner to business units by providing management, review, analysis and advisory services of the financial and capital resources. This is an associate level position within Infrastructure Financial Planning & Analysis Job Family which performs business partnership overseeing infrastructure expenses, headcount, and allocation accuracy.


Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.



What you'll do in the role:

· Collaborate with a varied group of colleagues in Finance and across the Firm.

· Adhere to the Firm's risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls; proactively identify ways to reduce risk in work.

· Act as a culture carrier; embody and set an example of the Firm's values and hold yourself and others accountable to Firm standards.

· Partner with Infrastructure divisions overseeing and validating expenses, headcount, and allocation accuracy.

· Collaborate with Corporate Services to support corporate real estate strategy planning and initiatives across Asia region.

· Maintain and oversee corporate real estate and infrastructure budgets, forecasts, estimates and align with business priorities

· Drive transparency and informed decision making across non compensation expense categories.

· Perform detailed variance analysis and financial reviews to identify risks, opportunities, and optimization levers.

· Provide senior management with the relevant information and analysis in executive format to drive important decision making.

· Manage initiatives to improve Business Management process improvements to drive efficiencies.

· Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot, to identify, design, and deliver scalable process improvements and operational optimizations.


What you'll bring to the role:

· In-depth knowledge of Finance functional area, product and/or client segment and technical skills, as well as of industry and competitive environment.

· Ability to operate independently with respect to most job responsibilities.

· Ability to work autonomously and under pressure, and are a self-starter, willing to take ownership and accountability

· Ability to provide positive and constructive feedback and innovate processes.

· Thorough understanding of GAAP Accounting principles such as lease accounting and accrual basis accounting.

· Experience with financial budgeting & planning.

· Demonstrated ability to create concise and cogent management reporting.

· Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint including Pivot Tables, lookups, formulas, data manipulation, data presentation and AI tools (Co-pilot).

· Relevant experience in FP&A, Accounting and/or Business Management preferably in the Financial Services sector, with a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance and/or Business Administration would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years.  Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity
